description: Publish a signed-in shopper's rating and review for their provider-verified completed Square checkout; requires reviews:write. Returns ok, review_id and already_submitted on success. Obtain approval for the exact public text. One review per booking; repeats return the original. Optional residency and up to three recommend_tags must be explicitly chosen by the shopper, never inferred; they appear only in aggregate totals when enough reviews exist.

recommend_tags.description: Optional. Up to three distinct reasons the shopper recommends the place, chosen by the shopper. Only with a rating of 4 or 5.

residency.description: Optional. Only what the shopper chose when asked: 'local' for "I live here", 'visiting' for "I'm visiting". Never infer it from location, address or history; omit it when the shopper does not choose.

name: submit_verified_review
title: Submit a verified review
